dct_description_sm: This repository contains the raw data for this study. The files are divided based on the figure they contributed to. Each figure folder has a README file that tells you what the files inside it mean. To see the code used to analyze and plot the raw data present, please go to the following GitHub repository (https://github.com/Tropini-lab/Enterocloster_inoviruses_data_and_code)
